task_instruction: Finish the card dragging mechanic for the alternate harness. The provided `res://scenes/main.tscn` harness keeps three `CardUI` instances under `ActionUI/Tray`, and each card should continue using the existing `CardStateMachine`, `CardBaseState`, `CardClickedState`, and `CardDraggingState` nodes from `res://scenes/card_ui/card_ui.tscn`. In `res://scenes/card_ui/card_state_machine.gd`, initialize every child state, connect each state's `transition_requested` signal, enter the exported `initial_state`, and forward `_input` and `gui_input` to the active state while ignoring transition requests that do not come from the current state. In `res://scenes/card_ui/card_ui.gd`, call `card_state_machine.init(self)` in `_ready()`, forward the existing input callbacks into the state machine, and keep `targets` updated from the `DropPointDetector` area enter/exit callbacks without duplicates. In the card state scripts, make the base state emit `reparent_requested`, reset `DropPointDetector.monitoring` to `false`, and move to the clicked state on left-click, make the clicked state record `original_index`, enable `DropPointDetector.monitoring`, and transition to dragging on mouse motion, make the dragging state reparent the card into the node in the `front_layer` group, follow the mouse, cancel back to base on right-click, and only confirm release after `DRAG_MINIMUM_THRESHOLD := 0.07` has elapsed, and make the released state immediately remove the card when `targets` is not empty but otherwise go back to base on the next input. In `res://scenes/ui/hand.gd`, connect each new card's `reparent_requested` signal and restore cancelled drags back into `Tray` at their recorded index.

--- original/scenes/card_ui/card_states/card_dragging_state.gd
+++ solver/scenes/card_ui/card_states/card_dragging_state.gd
@@ -1,3 +1,31 @@
 extends "res://scenes/card_ui/card_states/card_state.gd"
 
 const DRAG_MINIMUM_THRESHOLD := 0.07
+
+var drag_started_at_msec := 0
+
+
+func enter() -> void:
+	card_ui.state_label.text = "Dragging"
+	drag_started_at_msec = Time.get_ticks_msec()
+	var front_layer: Node = card_ui.get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("front_layer")
+	if front_layer:
+		card_ui.reparent(front_layer)
+	_follow_mouse()
+
+
+func on_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if event is InputEventMouseMotion:
+		_follow_mouse()
+
+	if event.is_action_pressed("right_mouse"):
+		transition_requested.emit(self, State.BASE)
+		return
+
+	var drag_duration := (Time.get_ticks_msec() - drag_started_at_msec) / 1000.0
+	if event.is_action_released("left_mouse") and drag_duration >= DRAG_MINIMUM_THRESHOLD:
+		transition_requested.emit(self, State.RELEASED)
+
+
+func _follow_mouse() -> void:
+	card_ui.global_position = card_ui.get_global_mouse_position() - card_ui.size / 2.0
